pullRequest.title: Fix the comments, docs and small test gaps from the #107 re-reviews
pullRequest.body:
Closes #273

Built by the large worker (MiMo-V2.6-Pro) as run 2 of 6 in #274, after two timeouts and one rework note each.

- The `leveled` comment in `victory_exp_row.gd` now says nothing reads it today and that `battle_scene.gd` uses `levels_gained`. No open task changes that, so it names none.
- `button_record` takes the button id and raises a `ValueError` naming the button and the character when an up-state record is not a shape.
- `test_panel_recipe.gd` no longer types the shadow values. `test_screen_rects.gd` already compares the material with the SWF.
- `func run()` in `post_run.gd` is now `-> void`. `GutHookScript.run()` has no return type, so "match" could also mean untyped.

Verification: `just pytest` 420 passed, `just gut` 784 of 784. With the `word_wrap` arm removed from `text_record`, the new pytest case fails.

nodes.title: Fix the comments, docs and small test gaps from the #107 re-reviews
nodes.body:
## Parent

#107

Spec: `spec/107-ui-foundation.md`, `spec/107-abilities.md`, `spec/107-victory.md`. The #187 and #198 items have no spec.

The re-reviews of #187, #198, #206, #208, #210, #229, #236 and #239 found these comment, doc and small test problems. Each one is still on `main` at `d711450e`. This issue changes `screen_rects.py` and `test_screen_rects.gd`, so it waits for the rect test issue to merge.

## What to build

**Comments and docs that say something false or incomplete**
- #198: `test/integration/test_battle_scene.gd:3659` says "A Shock lands on its Dispatch frame". The new test proves it lands 1 frame later. Write that a Shock shows 1 frame after its Dispatch on both runs, so the frames still compare.
- #198: `scripts/battle/battle_scene.gd:703` cites conductor lines 450-468. The sound plays at line 449. Cite 449-468.
- #198: `DECODED_ALGORITHMS.md:87` says the conductor creates each bolt with `attachMovie` at line 430. Line 430 calls `krinBoltMake`, which attaches the bolt at `frame_42/DoAction_4.as:140`.
- #187: `test/post_run.gd:5-11` states the audio-thread race as fact. Add that the cause comes from reading `audio_server.cpp` and from 5 of 10 runs leaking without the hook against 0 of 10 with it, and that no verbose log named the objects.
- #187: `post_run.gd:5-6` names only the hub and the main menu. `play_menu_music()` is also called from `battle_scene.gd:501,920`, `game.gd:25` and `hotbar.gd:66`. Write "tests that start menu music (the menu, the hub or the end of a battle)". Change "In 2026-11-11 tests" to "In tests on 2026-11-11".
- #236: ADR 0007 does not list the plus button's hover and pressed fills (`lightened(0.25)` and `darkened(0.25)`, `scripts/ui/menu/abilities_window.gd:110`). The SWF's button 3068 swaps shape 3065 for the white shape 3066 instead. Add both to the ADR's plus-button item.
- #236: `dev/tests/test_screen_rects.py:301` says shape 3065 is a black plate under the gradient 3064. 3065 is at depth 2, over 3064, and it is the black glyph and its outline. `abilities_window.gd:103` calls shapes 3064 to 3067 "a gradient plate": only 3064 is.
- #239: `scripts/ui/menu/victory_exp_row.gd:22-23` says the player's row sets `playerLeveled`. Nothing reads `.leveled`. `battle_scene.gd:892` uses `levels_gained`. Say what happens today and which task changes it.
- #210: the header comment of `screen_rects.py` says an art piece's depth means the two extractors cannot name different placements. For stage-measured art, the code only checks that the depth exists. The rect and the PNG come from `window_chrome.json` by name.
- #229: `dev/urchin_dev/convert/menu_math.py:90` says "four statements". There are five (lines 104, 105, 106, 109 and 155 of the script).

**Small code and test fixes**
- #198: the new Shock test types `1` at `test_battle_scene.gd:2565,2592`. Use `SHOCK_LANDS_AFTER_DISPATCH`.
- #187: `func run()` in `post_run.gd:19` has no return type. Match `GutHookScript.run()`.
- #208: delete the unused `COLOR_TOLERANCE` in `test_screen_rects.gd:11`.
- #206: drop the typed shadow asserts (5.0, 5.0, 45.0) in `test/unit/test_panel_recipe.gd:64-66`. `test_screen_rects.gd:79-85` already compares the material with the SWF.
- #236: no test covers the `word_wrap` arm of the line-pitch condition (`screen_rects.py:363`). A mutation that deleted it passed. Add `field(font_height=240, leading=40, word_wrap=True)` with `multiline=False`, and expect a pitch of 14.0.
- #236: `button_record` fails with a bare `KeyError` when an up-state record is not a shape (`screen_rects.py:461,479`). Raise a `ValueError` that names the button and the character.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every comment above is true and complete, by the three tests in CODING_STANDARDS.md.
- [ ] ADR 0007 lists the plus button's hover and pressed fills.
- [ ] The word_wrap mutation fails `dev/tests/test_screen_rects.py`.
- [ ] A button with a sprite in its up state fails with a `ValueError` that names it.
- [ ] `just gut` and `just pytest` pass.

## Verification
`just gut` and `just pytest`.

parent.title: UI overhaul: faithful screens on native Godot containers
parent.body:
## Destination

A UI spec at `spec/107-ui-overhaul.md` that gives every screen and window a decided target layout and names the SWF pieces it's built from, plus ready-for-agent issues to build it. The map is done once nothing is left to decide, and the building happens in those issues.

## Notes

- **Look:** faithful to the original by default, with an ADR for any departure a player could notice,
